slides: Your muscles hate monotony.
Repeating the same rep range trains adaptation, not growth.
Introduce micro‑variations—tempo, range, or angle.
Your body responds to novelty, unlocking new fibers.
Change the script weekly and watch strength surge.
Decision fatigue is the silent thief of willpower.
Every small choice drains a finite mental budget.
Batch similar tasks—clothes, meals, emails—into one slot.
Your brain reserves energy for the decisions that matter.
Automate the trivial, reserve will for the big moves.
You can’t outrun a night without sleep.
Growth hormone peaks during deep REM cycles.
Lack of sleep spikes cortisol, sabotaging recovery.
Consistent 7‑9 hours aligns hormones with training.
Prioritize sleep like a lift; it’s the real performance booster.
Big goals drown in daily noise.
Your day is a collection of micro‑commitments.
Map each micro‑commitment to a future milestone.
When a task doesn’t trace back, drop it.
Every intentional act becomes a stepping stone.
